name: The Senator's Daughter
source:
Ancient Rome. Awesome story about searching the missing daughter of an influential senator. In the game you'll try the role of the ex-centurion, and now a free man named Vitus.

[From [url=https://kexboy.itch.io/the-senators-daughter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
古羅馬。一位權勢顯赫的元老失去了女兒的下落，一場精彩的尋人故事就此展開。你將扮演維圖斯，他曾是百夫長，如今是個自由人。

［取自[url=https://kexboy.itch.io/the-senators-daughter]Itch.io[/url]］
